name: Clacton On Sea Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at St James Church. Open Mon and Wed for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Clacton Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden at Marine Gardens. Grows seasonal vegetables and herbs with surplus available to residents. Therapeutic gardening sessions Tuesday mornings.
